type.name: llama.cpp server
type.description: Runs llama.cpp's llama-server with its chat page: a GGUF model from Hugging Face, a file, or a folder of models to pick from.

parameters.versionHelp: `latest`, or a release tag such as b12287. Update installs the newest release when this is `latest`.
parameters.variantHelp: The llama.cpp build for your hardware. Only the builds published for this platform can be installed.
parameters.modelSourceHelp: Where the server's model comes from.
parameters.hfRepoHelp: owner/name, e.g. ggml-org/gemma-3-1b-it-GGUF. The file is downloaded into the Models folder at install.
parameters.hfFileHelp: The .gguf file's path in the repository, e.g. gemma-3-1b-it-Q4_K_M.gguf. For a split model, the first part.
parameters.contextSizeHelp: Tokens of context (--ctx-size). 0 takes the model's own, which can need a lot of memory.
parameters.gpuLayersHelp: Layers offloaded to the GPU (--gpu-layers). Empty lets llama.cpp choose.
parameters.extraArgsHelp: More llama-server arguments, split as a shell would, e.g. --jinja --flash-attn on. --host and --port are set by Hanafubuki.

modelSources.directory: Models folder: pick one on the server's page

settings.githubMirrorHelp: How release downloads use the GitHub mirrors of sd-webui-all-in-one.
